title: The Lore pane's full mode follows the engine's sizing per DEC-154: rows - 11 inline, a dock ask from the drawn frame, the kept-width message, and tool answers that report the drawn size
description:
Source: DEC-154, ruled by opum-doc under Article 5 delegation (seq 227 and seq 230, recorded on opum-agent OPAG-1075 at origin/dev `ce2b3d2d`, read by ref 2026-10-03). Restated in opum-agent's fix instruction of 2026-10-03T15:13:10Z. It rests on LCLI-674's measurements of Claude Code 2.1.288 in real ptys and on cc-patch's decompiled engine arithmetic. quest-cli applies the same rules to the Quest board in its #486.

WHAT IS WRONG (LCLI-674 findings): the inline ask `rows - 6` exceeds the engine ceiling max(rows/3, rows - 11) by ~5, so full can never be granted as asked and the pane always showed the shortfall hint; the dock ask is computed from the conversation column (viewport.columns) -- a shrink request -- and a kept pluginPanes.dockColumns (80 on this machine) beats every request; the dashboard tool answers the asked size, photographed saying "the full size" while drawn=36 and ask=43 with the hint showing.

THE RULES TO IMPLEMENT (DEC-154; rule 2 as amended by seq 230):
1. Inline/main screen: full asks `rows - 11` (PROMPT_FLOOR_ROWS 8 + TRANSCRIPT_PEEK_ROWS 3), replacing `rows - 6`. Inline grants landing below the cap are accepted: the frame and controls take the difference.
2. Dock: terminal width = viewport.columns (the transcript column) + the pane's current drawn width + 1 (the divider), from the same render; clamp the ask to terminal width - 24. Ask ONCE per toggle (a person's z, or a tool call with full), using the latest render, never on a resize or a redraw. A stored full mode restored at session start asks once, on its first render.
3. A kept width is the person's choice. Never edit ~/.claude.json and never try to defeat it. While one holds, full says so plainly in the pane, e.g. "Width kept at 80 (you set it): drag the pane edge to change". Show no generic held hint, and never label it "Full screen".
4. Tool answers report the DRAWN size, never the asked one. Say "full size" only when drawn >= asked - 4. Otherwise give the drawn size and why, e.g. "Opened at 36 rows; the screen keeps room for the prompt". If the drawn size is unknown when the tool returns, say "full requested" and nothing more.
5. No cc-patch change.

CONSTRAINTS: stays within the 0.13.0 hold -- LCLI-665 is untouched and no version site changes. If a measurement contradicts a rule, report it to opum-agent with the evidence rather than diverging. Report the PR and its head SHA to opum-agent when ready for a by-ref spot-check. The landing must reach dev before LCLI-665's bump so the release carries the DEC-154 behaviour.

SURFACE: hooks/register.tsx (the full-screen toggle section: `wantedSize`, `DOCK_MARGIN_COLUMNS` / `PROMPT_AREA_ROWS`, `FULL_HINT`, the dashboard tool's `full` arm, the ui.render size block and the once-only `lastRequest` guard), tests/pane.test.tsx (the toggle-args, viewport-change and drag-hint tests assert the OLD constants and must move to the new ones -- note the existing "asks again when the viewport changed" test contradicts amended rule 2), docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md (its Full screen section documents the 20-column margin, PROMPT_AREA_ROWS and the re-request on viewport change). Design of record: opum-doc docs/reference/pane-full-screen-and-quest-migration-skill-design.md section 1 as amended for DEC-154; NOTE its "Sizing details" bullet still says "again whenever the viewport size changes" where the ruling says never on a resize -- follow the ruling (both restatements agree), and the discrepancy is reported to opum-agent for opum-doc.

PRECEDENT: LCLI-666 (the toggle and layout this refines), LCLI-674 (the measurements), LCLI-668 (the dashboard tool), LCLI-664 (the mod and its harness).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Inline full mode asks rows - 11 (PROMPT_FLOOR_ROWS 8 plus TRANSCRIPT_PEEK_ROWS 3) on every path that raises it -- the person's z, the dashboard tool's full argument, and a stored full mode's first render -- asserted by the mod harness against the open args of a named inline render, with no path still asking rows - 6.

Dock full mode computes its ask from the same render: viewport.columns plus the pane's current drawn width plus 1 for the divider, clamped to terminal width - 24, and no ask is computed from the conversation width alone; the mod harness asserts the open args of a named dock render.

The ask is made once per toggle using the latest render: a later render of an already-full pane at a changed viewport issues no new open, and a stored full mode makes exactly one ask on its first render, both asserted in the mod harness.

While a kept or chosen width holds (drawn short of the ask by more than 4 in the dock), the pane shows the kept-width line naming the drawn width, e.g. Width kept at 80 (you set it): drag the pane edge to change; the generic held hint is gone, and no pane surface labels the state Full screen while it is kept; an inline pane short of its ask shows no hint. Asserted in the mod harness.

The dashboard tool's answer reports the drawn size and never the asked one: full size only when drawn >= asked - 4 from the latest render; otherwise the drawn size and the reason, e.g. Opened at 36 rows; the screen keeps room for the prompt; when no completed draw fixes the drawn size at answer time, full requested and nothing more. Driven in the mod harness against recorded draw states.

No cc-patch change and no write or workaround touching ~/.claude.json; the diff leaves every LCLI-665 version site untouched (no package.json, npm manifests, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, CHANGELOG or lockfile change), as the 0.13.0 hold requires.

On the head: bun run test:mod passes with the new tests, bun test passes, and bun run lore check exits 0 with the pane doc updated; any workstation-only failure is named with its reachability from this diff stated, and the mod typecheck state (clean, or NOT TYPECHECKED with the declaration named) is recorded.
The PR and its head SHA are reported to opum-agent for a by-ref spot-check, naming which DEC-154 rule each new test pins.

plan: Re-read the toggle, size and hint code in hooks/register.tsx and the existing expectations in tests/pane.test.tsx; enumerate every constant and test that moves.

Rewrite the sizing in hooks/register.tsx per DEC-154: inline rows - 11; dock ask from viewport.columns + drawn width + 1 clamped to terminal width - 24; ask once per toggle with a stored full mode asking once on its first render; kept-width line in place of the generic hint; tool answers from the latest recorded draw (drawn, never asked).

Move tests/pane.test.tsx to the new expectations: open args at named inline and dock renders, no re-ask on a changed viewport, exactly one ask for a restored full mode, the kept-width line, and the drawn-size tool answers; keep the split-layout and store tests green.
Update docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md Full screen section through the lore workflow, then bun run lore check.
Run the gates on the head: bun run test:mod, bun test, bun run lore check; record the typecheck state and any workstation-only failure with its reachability.

Dispatch a reviewer pass over the diff before landing; then PR into dev, required checks green on the head, squash merge, close LCLI-675 in the delivering PR, and report the PR and head SHA to opum-agent.
